text:
Situation: Carboplatin has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2023-04-28 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale Lakeside holds only 1.5 to 2.5 days of supply across two vial sizes. Corvale East holds 15 to 21 days of supply and can support transfers. Corvale General holds 8.7 to 9 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the carboplatin shortage on 2023-04-28; status is Current as of 2026-10-21. Accord Healthcare Inc. (NDC 16729-295-12) is listed with manufacturing by Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473). FDA inspection 1191818 of Intas ended 2022-12-02, classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2023-04-05.

Our position: We have Teva-labeled carboplatin 10 mg/mL 60 mL vials (NDC 00703423901) from PHARMACHEMIE BV at Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside. Internal transfers can stabilize Lakeside within days. Alternate manufacturers are approved but require pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 vials of 10 mg/mL 60 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 10 vials of 10 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Transfer 14 vials of 10 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale East to Corvale General — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
4. Use Teva Parenteral Medicines, Inc. carboplatin 10 mg/mL as alternate manufacturer — approved by pharmacist (Casey Nguyen, MD approved 2026-01-18).
5. Use Apotex Corp. carboplatin 10 mg/mL as alternate product — approved by pharmacist (Alex Morgan, PharmD approved 2026-05-16).

Not recommended: Delaying transfers while Lakeside remains below 3 days of supply.
